claims.text: Threshold questions
Why the table and the push dialog disagree.
Why the table and the push dialog disagree, and what the second option really does.
claims.note: The second option lifts every below-threshold % Adj. to the threshold, zeros included, unless Exclude Zeros is ticked (sa-main-toolbar.component.ts:442-453).

claims.text: Settings › Minimum Threshold
The Spatial Adjust dashboard, at /spatialadjust.
claims.note: The route is /spatialadjust. Reworded from dashboard-overview/where/1.

claims.text: No dialog open.
claims.note: The guide starts on the dashboard with no dialog open; every dialog here opens only on a user action. Reworded from dashboard-overview/where/1.

claims.text: A Spatial Adjust account on a site with TurfRad scan data.
claims.note: Reworded from dashboard-overview/before/1.

claims.text: The threshold is a site setting, so it applies to every user on the site.
claims.note: The threshold is stored once on the site, so every user of the site sees the same value. Reworded from minimum-threshold/before/1, minimum-threshold/before/2.

claims.text: The threshold is applied when you push, not when the suggestion is calculated.
claims.note: See minimum-threshold/before/3.

claims.text: The table shows the raw suggestion
Read [[Suggested]] for the station in the table.
claims.note: Suggested is a column of the station table under Adjustment (sa-dash-table.component.html:17-20). Reworded from threshold-questions/1/1, threshold-questions/1/4.

claims.text: With a threshold of 10, a station that suggests 6 still shows 6 here.
claims.note: Illustrative values; the table never shows the threshold. Reworded from threshold-questions/1/2, threshold-questions/1/3.

claims.text: If you expected the threshold here, it is applied only in the [[Push Changes]] dialog and to what is sent to Lynx.
claims.note: The rules are applied to the push list only. Reworded from threshold-questions/1/3.

claims.text: The raw suggested value, untouched by the threshold.
The push dialog shows what will be sent
In the [[Push Changes]] dialog, find the station’s row.
claims.note: The push dialog is titled Push Changes. Reworded from threshold-questions/2/1, threshold-questions/2/2.

claims.text: The row shows the original value, then Adjusted to and the value that will be sent, and a pink banner counts the rows changed.
claims.note: A rewritten row shows its % Adj., an arrow and Adjusted to the new value; the pink banner counts the stations altered. Reworded from threshold-questions/2/2.

claims.text: If the dialog is not open, select [[Push Changes]] at the right of the toolbar.
claims.note: The Push Changes button is in the right-hand part of the toolbar (sa-main-toolbar.component.html:34-41). Reworded from push-to-lynx/where/1, push-to-lynx/1/1.

claims.text: If there is no banner, see the last step.
claims.note: The banner is hidden when the threshold is 0 or no pending % Adj. is below it (sa-confirm-push-dlg.component.html:32). Reworded from threshold-questions/5/3.

claims.text: The table and this dialog differ on purpose: the threshold applies only to what is sent.
claims.note: The disagreement is intended: the tab header says the threshold prevents very small adjustments from being pushed. Reworded from threshold-questions/2/3, threshold-questions/1/3.

claims.text: Original and rewritten values, shown together.
Choose what below-threshold means
Find the two options under [[Minimum Threshold (%)]] on the [[Minimum Threshold]] tab of [[Settings]].
claims.note: The two options sit under the Minimum Threshold (%) box on the Minimum Threshold tab (sa-settings-dlg.component.html:135-170); Minimum Threshold is a hardcoded rail title (sa-settings-dlg.component.ts:54). Reworded from threshold-questions/where/1, threshold-questions/3/1, minimum-threshold/1/1.

claims.text: [[Set to zero when pushed to Lynx]] sends 0 to Lynx, and [[Set to the minimum threshold value when pushed to Lynx]] sends the threshold.
claims.note: One option sends below-threshold values as 0 and the other sends them as the threshold. Reworded from threshold-questions/3/2, threshold-questions/3/3, threshold-questions/3/4.

claims.text: If both options are greyed out, the threshold is 0, which turns the feature off.
claims.note: The option group is disabled at a threshold of 0. Reworded from threshold-questions/5/2, minimum-threshold/before/4.

claims.text: Two options, opposite outcomes.
Exclude Zeros protects genuine zeros
Find [[Exclude Zeros]] below the two options.
claims.note: Exclude Zeros sits under the second option. Reworded from threshold-questions/4/4, threshold-questions/4/2.

claims.text: Tick it, and a station at a true zero stays at 0 instead of being lifted to the threshold.
claims.note: A true zero is a % Adj. of 0, whether calculated or typed. Reworded from threshold-questions/4/2.

claims.text: If [[Exclude Zeros]] is greyed out, select [[Set to the minimum threshold value when pushed to Lynx]] first.
claims.note: Exclude Zeros is enabled only for the second option. Reworded from threshold-questions/4/4.

claims.text: Without it, a station that needs no water still gets a small run.
claims.note: It applies to a pending station, one whose % Adj. of 0 differs from what Lynx holds. Reworded from threshold-questions/4/3.

claims.text: Exclude Zeros is enabled only for the second option.
Zero disables the feature
Read the [[Minimum Threshold (%)]] box.
claims.note: The box is SETTINGS_MIN_THRESHOLD, Minimum Threshold (%) (en-us.json:469). Reworded from threshold-questions/where/1, threshold-questions/5/1.

claims.text: It holds a number above 0, so the threshold is on and the banner can show.
claims.note: Above 0 the feature is on; the banner also needs a pending % Adj. below the threshold, so it can show, not that it will. Reworded from threshold-questions/5/2, threshold-questions/5/3.

claims.text: If it reads 0, the threshold is off and the options are greyed out.
claims.note: The option group is greyed out at 0. Reworded from threshold-questions/5/2, threshold-questions/5/4.

claims.text: The setting is site-wide, so someone else may have cleared it.
claims.note: The threshold is stored once on the site. Reworded from threshold-questions/5/3, minimum-threshold/before/2.

claims.text: After you use [[Review Threshold]], the gear button opens on this tab until the page is reloaded.
claims.note: "The rest of the session" means until the page is reloaded. Reworded from threshold-questions/5/5, minimum-threshold/1/3.

claims.text: A threshold of 0 disables the feature.
You can explain why the table and the push dialog differ.
You know which option needs Exclude Zeros.
claims.note: Exclude Zeros belongs to "Set to the minimum threshold value when pushed to Lynx".
